items.text: To what extent did this approach’s final outcome meet the task requirements?
items.help: Consider both the requested change and the settings that were supposed to stay unchanged.

items.text: Overall, how difficult or easy was it to make this adjustment using this approach?
items.source: SEQ 改编：限定本次调整及当前策略；并行评价的使用情境也不同于独立完成任务

items.text: With this approach, I felt in control of the changes made to the tutor.
items.source: SASSI Table 4 控制感内容改编：一般交互改为 tutor 修改，采用本项目七点量尺

items.text: This approach’s decision about whether to ask for clarification suited my needs in this task.
items.source: 项目专用题，不声称来自标准量表

items.text: Overall, I am satisfied with my experience of making this adjustment using this approach.
items.source: 项目自编单题满意度；不称 SUS 或 SASSI 分数

items.text: To what extent did the tutor’s final setup match what you wanted by the end of the conversation?
items.source: 项目自编；自然情境没有统一正确终态，结束不等于达标

items.text: The tutor’s responses reflected the meaning of what I was trying to communicate.
items.source: 受 SASSI System Response Accuracy 启发；关注感知的意思理解，不是客观 STT 准确率；本题为概念改写，不是原题照用

items.text: I knew how to phrase my requests so that the tutor could respond to them.
items.source: SASSI Habitability 相关内容改编；识别参与者是否不断猜测应该怎么说

items.text: I felt in control of the changes made to the tutor throughout the conversation.
items.source: SASSI 控制感内容改编；评价整段交流而非一个修改回合

items.text: The tutor’s decisions about whether to ask for clarification suited my needs during the conversation.
items.source: 项目专用；包括决定不询问的情况，不预设询问越少越好

items.text: The tutor’s clarification questions disrupted the flow of the conversation more than I wanted.
items.source: 项目专用，非 SASSI 原题；将打断对象限定为澄清问题，区分可接受澄清与非期望打断

items.text: How much thinking and concentration did interacting with the tutor require during this conversation?
items.source: 参考 NASA-TLX Mental Demand 改写；以整段交互所需思考/注意力替代旧省力题；不是完整工作负荷工具

items.text: Overall, I am satisfied with my experience of personalizing the tutor during this conversation.
items.source: 项目自编；保留定制体验满意度，不能把 SUS 的整体可用性等同满意度
